C9044.actual_part: BOOMELE 2.54-2*25P, 2x25 (50P) IDC box header, 2.54mm, straight, through-hole

C9144.actual_part: BOOMELE 2.54-2*10P, 2x10 (20P) IDC box header, 2.54mm, RIGHT ANGLE, through-hole (~9.4k stock)
C9144.note: Footprint audit: both boards use Connector_IDC:IDC-Header_2x10_P2.54mm_Vertical (straight), and the 2x25 C9044 is the straight variant, so the design intent is vertical - C9144 (right-angle) does not match. Replace with a STRAIGHT 2x10 box header: JXTCONN IDC2.54-2*10PZ C53207551 (~147 stock) or DC2.54-2*10PZ C53207553 (~70 stock); both low stock - or buy any generic straight 2x10 box header off-BOM since it is hand-soldered anyway. Alternatively keep C9144 and change the footprint to IDC-Header_2x10_P2.54mm_Horizontal.
